doc.title: Monthly Updates [November]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Added a new FMHY backup domain: FMHY.lol

  • The FMHY SafeGuard extension is ready to be tested. Let us know how it works for you guys, and TY to everyone who made it happen.

  • Split FOSS and Freeware into separate sections and cleaned up formatting: Before vs. After.

  • Split Text Editors and Note-Taking into separate sections, added labels, and removed any that were low quality or abandoned.

  • Split Radio Stations and Podcasts into separate sections.

  • Added tags to bookmark managers and removed ones that looked low quality: Before vs. After.

  • Added tags to Remote Desktop and removed any that looked low quality: Before vs. After.

  • Added tags to Online Image Editors and removed any that didn't stand out: Before vs. After.

  • Added tags to Link in Bio and removed any that seemed low quality: Before vs. After.

  • Added a Special Interests section to Gaming to help debloat the main DDL section a bit.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred Bluesky in Fediverse Tools as many are leaving Twitter for it now.

  • Starred Kdenlive in Video Editors. Open-source, feature-rich, multi-platform editor.

  • Starred Khinsider in Game Soundtracks. Popular soundtrack site with a big library.

  • Starred Camo in Video Tools. Allows you to use any device as a webcam.

  • Starred FMSTREAM in Radio Streaming. The largest online radio directory on the internet.

  • Starred Thunderbird in Android Internet as it's just a better version of K-9 Mail.

  • Starred Pixlr in Online Image Editors. Feature-rich editor with a nice UI. Has a daily limit, but it can be bypassed with the script linked.

  • Starred x266.mov in Discord Tools. Allows you to embed large videos on Discord.

  • Starred Playlists.cloud in Spotify Tools. Unlimited playlist transfer between Spotify / Apple Music.

  • Starred InfiCourses in Course DDL. Big library with courses tough to find elsewhere.

  • Starred Excalidraw in Drawing Tools. Feature-rich compared to similar web apps.

  • Went through SMS Verification and starred ones that stood out the most.

Things Removed

  • Removed Mutaz as they no longer host cracked software.

  • Removed Fey as the free tier is too limited now.

  • Unstarred BetterDiscord as it runs poorly for many people due to bad optimization, and there are better options like Vencord.

  • Unstarred OlaMovies as they now require Google logins.

  • Unstarred PDALife as many apps are outdated, their official app isn't maintained, and there are better sites.

  • Unstarred Not Diamond as it isn't unlimited anymore.

  • Unstarred ElevenLabs as it's capped at 10 mins, limiting its usefulness.
